verdict.rationale: There is no downloadable OpenAPI document: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The product does offer machine-readable equivalents. The UCP CLI can fetch each merchant's live input schema via `--input-schema`, and the underlying UCP protocol publishes a versioned specification and reference implementations openly on ucp.dev and GitHub. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) file for Shopify's agent endpoints, explicit evidence that the published UCP spec ships as machine-readable schema files rather than prose docs, and hands-on confirmation of downloading and using such a spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use `--input-schema` against any of these commands to fetch the merchant's live input schema before composing a payload.
The complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations are hosted in our public GitHub repository.
the Universal Commerce Protocol spec is published in the open — https://ucp.dev/llms.txt serves the versioned specification index
